prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a passenger and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1060; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Witnesses and the officer say the claimant was not in the vehicle when the crash happened.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane on a Conroe, Texas roadway when Driver 1 attempted to move into the right lane and made contact with the side of Driver 2's vehicle, producing a sideswipe collision. Driver 2 confirmed the sequence of events at the scene, and two independent witnesses gave statements consistent with that account. Scene photographs show scraping and deformation along the right rear quarter panel of Driver 2's vehicle and the left front area of Driver 1's vehicle, which fits the angle and force of the impact described by all parties. Driver 1 identified the owner of the vehicle as the policyholder and stated that the driver resides in the same household. Passenger reported a knee injury and said Passenger was seated in the front right position at the time of impact. Both witnesses and the responding officer stated that Passenger was not inside the vehicle when the collision occurred, and no one at the scene could account for Passenger's whereabouts at that moment. No prior damage to either vehicle was observed or reported. Passenger was evaluated by emergency medical personnel on scene and transported for further examination.
